reports.title: AMERICAN WATER REPORTS SOLID THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

lines: INITIATES STANDALONE 2027 EPS GUIDANCE, REFLECTING GROWTH OF 8%
•2026 adjusted earnings per share (EPS) guidance range is narrowed to $6.07 to $6.12 from $6.02 to $6.12; long-term targets affirmed
•Initiating standalone 2027 earnings per share guidance range of $6.53 to $6.63
The company’s 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range has been narrowed to $6.07 to $6.12, from the previous 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range of $6.02 to $6.12.
• 2027 standalone adjusted earnings per share guidance range of $6.53 to $6.63 established, 8% EPS growth at midpoint compared to 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range.
